spec.description:
Higgins Builders Acoustic Baffle for Party Walls is a
high-density, custom-manufactured polyester sound absorber engineered to stop
sound transfer through ceiling voids above party walls. Manufactured in
Queensland, Australia from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibers containing up
to 85% recycled PET, it acts as a resilient acoustic barrier in
multi-residential inter-tenancy wall-to-roof junctions. Safe and itch-free to
install without protective clothing, it provides high sound transmission loss
and will not slump or deteriorate over time.
features:

low-allergen buildings

install:
Measure the ceiling
cavity void above the fire-rated party wall or inter-tenancy partition

Position Builders Acoustic Baffle directly above the wall line spanning from
the top plate to the underside of roof cladding

Ensure the baffle compresses
snugly against rafters, purlins, and ceiling linings without gaps

Overlap or
butt adjoining baffle blocks tightly together to eliminate acoustic flanking
paths

Secure in place using friction-fit pressure or mechanical
fasteners/strapping where required

Ensure baffle does not obstruct mandatory
roof space ventilation pathways
selection_checklist:
Confirm cavity
height between top of party wall and underside of roof

Verify inter-tenancy
acoustic rating (Rw + Ctr) requirement under the NCC

Measure linear meterage
of party walls requiring ceiling void acoustic baffling
limitations:
Indoor ceiling space use only;
not for direct external weather exposure

Does not substitute for fire-rated
stonewool where a specific FRL is required by structural engineers

Ensure
proper clearances around non-IC rated light fittings and hot flues
spec.warranty: Lifetime performance guarantee backed by Higgins Insulation

retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation Higgins Builders Baffle is a high-density
polyester acoustic sound absorber engineered specifically to stop sound transfer
through ceiling voids above party walls in Class 1 and Class 2 multi-residential
buildings. Manufactured in Queensland from 100% thermally bonded polyester
containing up to 85% recycled PET, it friction-fits between the top of the wall
and the roofline to block acoustic flanking paths. Completely itch-free,
non-toxic, hydrophobic, and fire-tested to AS/NZS 1530.3, it provides a safe,
permanent acoustic barrier between adjoining tenancies.
